source.title: The Lyapin's notebook: a collection of unsolved problems in Semigroup Theory

needs_review.question_text_raw: The source resolved to the exact arXiv work and the arXiv HTML full text exposes numbered Problem blocks 1.1 through 7.4. A complete extraction pass identified 49 accepted self-contained questions and 9 notation-damaged review items, but the complete JSON could not be locally persisted in this Codex CLI environment: apply_patch could not write files, ordinary shell writes intermittently failed with bwrap loopback errors, and the only working local-file upload path, curl to file:// from a PTY, truncated payloads at 4096 bytes. This compact failure JSON was saved instead so the run has a durable checkpoint.
